content: Our analysis indicates that OSG conversations satisfy higher number of conditions approximating therapeutic factors than Twitter conversations. Given this outcome, we postulate that users who join support group websites spontaneously seem to benefit from it. Indeed, as shown in Section SECREF5, the original posters who interact with others by replying to comments, have benefited from an improvement of their emotional state.
